access_notes: Viewed 2026-11-14 (T-3553) from the museum's open-access image and object record: a brown silk velvet afternoon dress by Jeanne Hallée: a cream lace collar and lace at the wrists, the bodice crossed by bands of lighter ribbon, the skirt's hem trimmed with crossing and horizontal ribbon bands. A real garment, French, not of Chicago and not of anyone drawn in the town.
note: One of the T-3553 finery references (docs/RESEARCH/finery-3553/README.md): the velvet dress.

what_it_does_not_supply: how any Prairie Avenue woman dressed, or the colour of any dress she owned
how often such a dress was worn on a Chicago street in 1904
